Autonomy is the ability to be self-reliant.

== On an individual level ==

''[[Source:No Limits to Learning (Book)|Botkin et al.]]''defines '''individual autonomy''' as the capability to make decisions and act freely to fulfil their interest, which is not only limited by hard/soft boundaries such as local [[law]] or societal/moral expectations, but also personal capacity in understanding and critically reflecting on situations to make decisions and take actions that facilitates desirable outcomes.<ref>{{#cite:Q2658}}</ref>
